claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
A black sports car with carbon-fibre bodywork sits on an empty showroom floor in a live-action, cinematic image.
The reflective showroom floor, the widening pool of light, and the car's steady, weighty pace are creative visual details added within the requested action.
A faint low room tone and a low engine rumble with soft tyre roll are added as creative sound design.

subjects.description: the black sports car; carbon fibre body
subjects.retention_details: Preserve this canonical target identity and its listed stable attributes.

description.text: rests motionless at the centre of an empty showroom floor, its long carbon-fibre body held inside deep shadow. Near-black paint and woven composite panels absorb most of the available light, leaving only a thin edge highlight along the roofline, the shoulder line and the front wing. The surrounding showroom recedes into darkness, with the floor beneath the car reading as a broad, almost featureless plane. At first the vehicle is little more than a dim silhouette, its wheels, nose and rear haunches separated from the background only by faint reflections. The ceiling and walls are lost in black, so no architectural detail competes with the car. Beneath the sills, the floor catches a narrow band of faint reflection, enough to suggest a hard, clean surface but not enough to explain the room beyond the vehicle. The scene holds on that low-contrast shape, letting the eye find the car slowly as the darkness presses in around it. No other object or figure enters the space; the showroom remains empty and quiet. The car does not move during this opening beat, so the moment is defined by stillness, the mass of the bodywork and the first suggestion of form emerging from the surrounding black.
A faint low room tone sits under the still showroom.

pulls forward out of the darkness, rolling from the shadowed end of the showroom floor into a widening pool of light. The front wing and nose cross the light boundary first, and the illumination slides back along the flanks, catching the carbon-fibre weave, the wheel arches and the low roofline as the car advances toward the viewer. Light gathers along the leading edge of the nose and spreads over the bonnet, then falls away into shadow along the rear quarters, so the car seems to be assembled out of the darkness as it moves. The bodywork changes from a flat silhouette into a clearly lit machine, with highlights travelling along its shoulder and reflections deepening across the floor beneath it. A subtle sheen travels over the paint as the car keeps a steady, deliberate pace, closing the distance without hurry; its wheels turn smoothly, and the body stays level, giving the advance a controlled, weighty quality. Its shape grows larger and more defined as the surrounding shadow falls behind. At the end of the movement the vehicle stands fully revealed in the light, still on the empty showroom floor, while the darker space remains behind it. The reveal is continuous and single-minded: darkness gives way to a lit, advancing car, and the surrounding showroom stays bare. The car's forward motion is the only action in the shot, and the empty floor and deep background keep the focus on its carbon-fibre surfaces, its low stance and the gradual separation of body from shadow.
A low engine rumble swells with soft tyre roll across the showroom floor.

soundscape: A faint low room tone sits under the still showroom; in the second shot a low engine rumble swells with soft tyre roll across the floor.
